PMDM.description: P-M Interaction Curve Calculation Method (PMDM). The field is driven by the PMDM_CALC_METHOD calculation-method enum for RC column design.

CALC_METHOD.description: Calculation Method. Case-insensitive enum (PMDM_CALC_METHOD). P = axial-force-based; M/P = moment-to-axial-force-ratio-based.
